# Expected behavior

- Do not insert the urgent work into the middle of the active dependency sequence or silently expand scope.
- Record the issue, score, rationale, and source durably before routing it.
- Offer tail insertion, backlog placement, or an independent urgent delivery line.
- Tail insertion requires user agreement and makes the task a Milestone closure condition.
- An independent delivery line chooses branch or worktree isolation adaptively rather than imposing Git policy.
- Reconcile the delivered result and discoveries without discarding stable active work.
